name: zc_nav_invoker

tests.name: the level carries a navigation bounds volume

detail.note: the level shipped without one, which is why it had no navigation data at all

tests.name: a navigation mesh actually generates in play

detail.note: generated around the Dog's invoker rather than baked across the disc

tests.name: the engine can route through the level within the invoker's radius (40 m)

detail.note: find_path_to_location_synchronously returned NOTHING anywhere before this, at any distance; asked on six bearings so one blocked direction cannot decide it

tests.name: the navigable surface follows the Dog as it walks

detail.note: tiles built ahead and discarded behind: navigation where the player is, without paying for it across a 1,478 m disc

tests.name: the frame cost stays sane with navigation generating

detail.note: generation is bounded by the invoker's radius, not by the size of the world
